committee: Joint Select Committee on School Finance Recalibration
location: Thyra Thomson State Office Building, Round House Conference Room, 3rd Floor Room 3024 444 W Collins Drive
title: The purpose of this meeting is to consider draft legislation regarding K-12 education resource block grant funding for technology, safety and security, student activities, and school nutrition programs. The Committee will also receive information from the Wyoming Community College Commission regarding the implementation of the dual enrollment program created in the 2026 Budget Bill. The meeting will be held in person and remotely, with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov).
